metadata.title: EOS MCP Experimental Tools Register
metadata.purpose: Track early-stage or evolving tools undergoing validation

tools.name: eos.compiler.l0.parse
tools.description: L0 Golden Language ISO/IEC 14977 EBNF ontological parser and AST generator.
tools.notes: Real parser implementation with EBNF validation, but grammar is specialized for EOS internal AST specifications.

tools.name: eos.core.triamazikamno.synthesize
tools.description: Dialectical in-memory AST synthesis balancing thesis, antithesis, and conciliation forces.
tools.notes: Executes mathematical balance calculation over proposal objects in memory.

tools.name: eos.justice.adjudicate
tools.description: Deterministic DAG fork adjudication and four-tier conflict resolution with zero-waste pruning.
tools.notes: Pure algorithmic comparator evaluating DAG node weight and SHA-256 lineage.

tools.name: eos.blueprint.run
tools.notes: Can execute full DAG, but defaults allow_simulated_gates: true for automated passes.

tools.name: eos.audit.parallel_dag.run
tools.description: Parallel auditor DAG runner present in switch case but absent from CANONICAL_TOOLS.
tools.notes: Blocked by handleToolCall UNKNOWN_TOOL check because it is not in CANONICAL_TOOLS array.
